description: The nanolathe over its target: an aircraft plant with a commander on open ground beside it, ARM rich in metal and energy. Select the plant (`tacli click` on it) and queue aircraft (`tacli ui <i> click ARMATLAS`, repeatedly) so it sprays onto the nanoframe on its pad; order the commander to guard the plant (`tacli order <i> --unit 3 --expect ARMCOM defend unit 2`) so its spray lands there too. The spray is particle layer 6 and must read OVER the pad and the nanoframe, at 1x and zoomed in.
